## [1.1.0-dev.3](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/compare/v1.1.0-dev.2...v1.1.0-dev.3) (2026-11-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* compile error against Morphe patcher 2.3.0 ([d9e6b4a](https://github.com/vippium/brokenn-patches/commit/d9e6b4a9db8b1cb5b4240c29b66cc6e1a778e581))

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses app signature verification to allow API access.

patches.name: Enable all codecs
patches.description: Unlocks H.265, VP9, AV1 and 4K playback on capable devices.

patches.name: Enable screen mirroring
patches.description: Allows playback while screen mirroring or HDMI is connected.

patches.name: Force HDR10
patches.description: Enables HDR10 and HDR10+ playback on compatible devices.

patches.name: Monochrome icon support
patches.description: Adds a themed-icon version of the launcher icon for Android 13+.

patches.name: Premium unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium UI features, removes subscription nudges, and enables downloads.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes pre-roll, mid-roll, live-match and home-feed ads.

patches.name: Remove top bar switcher
patches.description: Removes the JioHotstar/Tadka mode-switcher row from the top of Home.
